data.name: Dorjee
data.long_meaning: Dorjee is a name of both Hindu and Buddhist origin. In Hinduism, it is a form of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, who holds the thunderbolt as a weapon. In Buddhism, Dorjee is the name of the Vajra, a symbol of indestructibility and fearlessness. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dharma-rajaya,' meaning 'ruler of righteousness,' and is associated with the qualities of fearlessness, courage, and protection.

In Hinduism, Dorjee is the name of a form of Lord Vishnu, known for his preservation and protection of the universe. In Buddhism, it is the name of the Vajra, a symbol of power, indestructibility, and fearlessness. The name Dorjee is significant in various rituals and ceremonies in both religions, reflecting their deep spiritual and cultural roots.
data.spiritual_significance: Dorjee is a name imbued with spiritual meaning and symbolizes powerful and positive qualities such as fearlessness, courage, protection, and righteousness. In Buddhism, the name is synonymous with the Vajra, a symbol of indestructibility and the ultimate reality beyond all worldly phenomena. Dorjee is an embodiment of the unchanging, eternal truth that underscores both religions, inspiring spiritual growth and inner peace.
